items.title: payments error/warning log lines (untrusted text)

items.body:
## What it means
The service is up but failing requests. In this shop it is almost always a **symptom**:
`orders` returns 503 when `catalog` or `payments` cannot answer.
## Fix
- Dependency down → fix the dependency first ([service-down.md](service-down.md)); this alert
  clears by itself about 2 minutes later (rate window).
- Started right after a deploy → `kubectl -n shop rollout undo deploy/<svc>`.
- Database errors → check `kubectl -n shop get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=postgres`.
items.title: high-error-rate.md (for HighErrorRate)

items.body:
## What it means
`orders` cannot reach `catalog` or `payments` (label `upstream`): connection refused,
timeout (2 s) or a non-200 answer. It points directly at the dependency to investigate.
## Fix
Fix the upstream service ([service-down.md](service-down.md)). Restarting `orders` does
**not** help: it is the messenger, not the cause.
